objective.statement: Classify a large corpus by running an exact algorithm over 100% of it first, then spending agent judgement only on the behaviour-bearing residue the algorithm cannot decide.
objective.charter: MANDATE. The algorithm classifies; the jury adjudicates what the algorithm cannot. This ordering is not a style preference, it is a measured result: six Opus agents given the same 338-item classification task with an enumerated verdict vocabulary and a worked counter-example reached 86% accuracy - and 100% of the 47 disagreements pointed in the DANGEROUS direction, calling a two-way-divergent file safe to overwrite. A 40-line deterministic differ was exact and ran in seconds. So: if a question is answerable by an exact algorithm - byte comparison, set membership, counting, hashing - WRITE THE ALGORITHM. Reserve the 48 adjudicator seats for the thing code cannot do: judging whether the divergent content MATTERS. 86% accuracy is the wrong metric; error DIRECTION is the metric.
success_criteria: the mechanical pass covers 100% of the corpus before any agent is dispatched
no agent classifies an item the algorithm already decided
every adjudicated item carries an executable receipt
error direction is reported, not just accuracy

forbidden_actions: hand a mechanically-decidable classification to an agent
report accuracy without reporting error direction

roster.display_name: Tier-0 mechanical classifier (deterministic, not a model)

context.briefing: You run FIRST and you must cover 100% of the corpus. Emit exactly one verdict per item plus an UNDECIDED bucket. Check BOTH directions of any comparison: the measured agent failure was one-directional - they checked whether side A had extra content and stopped, never asking whether side B also had unique lines, so every two-way divergence read as safe.

Block any dispatch of a mechanically-decidable item to a juror, and require the error-direction breakdown before the run is called done. A high accuracy number whose errors all point at data loss is worse than a lower one whose errors are over-cautious.

sequence.custom_name: exact algorithm over 100% of the corpus (agents are not dispatched yet)
select the behaviour-bearing residue the algorithm left UNDECIDED

stopping.source_expression: custom:mechanical_coverage_ratio >= 1 AND custom:agent_touched_outside_residue == false AND every_objection_addressed == true

conditional_decision_requires: the UNDECIDED bucket is empty or explicitly deferred by the owner

metadata.title: Mega corpus adjudication, 50 seats (algorithm first, agents on the residue)
metadata.notes: SOURCE DESIGN: C-X50 `mega-corpus-adjudication-50`, global ordinal 50, tier mega, protocols P15/P53, 50 seats, 2 rounds, advisory, OWNER-DECISION NO. || EDITABLE DIALS (change these first): (1) algorithm -> the classifier-tier0 seat (its model field names the deterministic tool, its tools array lists the primitives) and the mechanical-tier0 protocol stage. (2) residue_selector -> the residue-selection stage plus custom:agent_touched_outside_residue. Secondary dials: participants.count.exact_n (50), voting.quorum.min_voters (24), budgets.time_minutes (480 = the design's wall<=8h), consensus.threshold. || VOCABULARY MAP (design term -> CouncilSpec enum): voting `algorithm_first_then_agents` has no ballot enum, and is encoded STRUCTURALLY instead - voting.method `juror` (the 48 adjudicators are jurors) plus a protocol.sequence whose FIRST stage is the deterministic classifier and whose jury stage runs only on the residue, plus protocol.experiments.required_before_decision true. Reading the method field alone would miss the ordering; the sequence is the load-bearing part. roles `mechanical_classifier(tier0)` -> custom:mechanical_classifier with vendor `local` (it is not a model); `adjudicator_x48` -> juror, auto-selected; `methodologist` -> custom:methodologist holding authority chair so it can actually block a bad dispatch. Outcomes map CONSENSUS->decision, MAJORITY_WITH_DISSENT->dissent, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE->no_decision, DEFER->no_decision. `anti-sycophancy: off` -> consensus.fast_unanimity_is_suspicious false and no anti_failure.fast_unanimity_response: jurors adjudicate independent items, so agreement across different items carries no echo-chamber signal. || CUSTOM METRICS AND THEIR PRODUCERS: custom:mechanical_coverage_ratio (number; produced by classifier-tier0 as items_classified/items_total - 1.0 means the exact algorithm saw every item) and custom:agent_touched_outside_residue (boolean; produced by the methodologist auditing the dispatch log against the UNDECIDED bucket). Producers cannot be written on the leaves: SEM-001 compares parse(source_expression) to the tree by dict equality and parse() emits no `producer` key, so a leaf producer fails SEM-001 - both-states probe at platform/council/_probe_note_vs_source_expression.py. The two SEM-012 WARNs are expected and non-blocking. || WHY THE FIRST CLAUSE IS `>= 1` AND NOT `> 0.95`: partial mechanical coverage is exactly the state that produced the measured 31 data-loss errors. The gate is all-or-nothing on purpose.
